outcome: Site and displacement of BD Odon Device on fetal head
cohort: The study participants were three bespoke fetal mannequins representing different head sizes and a maternal mannequin used in 440 simulated operative vaginal births.
finding: The BD Odon Device reliably sited over a safe area of the fetal head in simulated births and generated similar levels of perineal distension compared with Kiwi ventouse or forceps when used correctly.
mod_finding: In occipito-posterior births, the BD Odon Device sited further down the fetal head compared to occipito-anterior or transverse positions.
